behaviors.description: DAW right-panel toggle controls actual world-source and cabinet wave nets and measured ray ribbons; outside the DAW they require worn glasses. Animated rays are a separate unlit overlay over retained paused-world color and depth, and never trigger optical baking or world recapture.
behaviors.selection: Authored spawn theatre enabled in the game; DAW only mode shares the same session model.

behaviors.description: The Sound speakers pause-menu option requires cheats and shows Blender-authored omni speaker models at published acoustic emitter positions, including moved wind; disabling cheats clears the option. This does not enable ray ribbons or require glasses.
behaviors.selection: Cheats enabled and Sound speakers selected in the macOS pause menu.
